purpose: Combination batch of the context network's sub-bar items, declared before any fit of these seeds. The GPU sprint (docs/adsb_ctx3/README.md) read three items that leaned positive and failed their bar alone: wider numeric embeddings (dnum16, +0.033 points), a doubled learning rate (lr2, +0.027) and a lightly masked network routed to unmatched rows (route_mask25, +0.054, interval touching zero). Their combination was never fitted. Question: does it clear the bar on the 32-epoch base?
prior: Moderate to low: the three single readings sum to about +0.11 points if they add, and each is inside its own noise.
hardware: Azure arcw0-arcw7 (Standard_D16ds_v7), CPU, tools/run_adsb_ctx3.py --device cpu --threads 8, two lanes per worker; every run of this declaration, the reference included, on that hardware. CPU because the user's compute rule puts context-network rounds on CPU unless turnaround matters.

protocol.data: tools/run_adsb_ctx3.py --fold design, unchanged: the seasonal fold's fit partition (2025-02..06, 08, 09, LIRF excluded), October monitored, October predictions only
protocol.never_read: No run of this declaration predicts, scores or reads a label of 2025-01, 2025-07, 2025-11, 2025-12 or of the ranking months. No official score enters. The published-aggregates sources (docs/published_means, docs/clean_line_screens/daily_totals.json) are not read.
protocol.masking: as configs/adsb_ctx3_design_v2.json: training only, each matched fitted row drawn with probability p at every step and shown as an unmatched row; prediction never masks

items.combo_dl: X = the dl32 seed mean on every row
items.route_m25: X = the ref32 seed mean on rows with adsb_matched = 1, the m25_32 seed mean on the other rows (the second batch's best item, measured again on fresh seeds)
items.combo_all: X = the dl32 seed mean on rows with adsb_matched = 1, the m25dl32 seed mean on the other rows

readings.pool: P = 0.5 x mean(ctx seeds 101-116) + 0.5 x mean(ctx_e24 seeds 117-132), seasonal-fold October predictions (the design sprint's pool; October non-LIRF 154.016 s, proxy at share 0.75 176.262 s)
readings.R1: October non-LIRF RMSE of each item's four-seed mean; matched / unmatched; by airport
readings.R2: recipe proxy (tools/nn_design_report.RecipeProxy, all October rows) of table = 0.25 committee + 0.75 [(1 - b) P + b X], b in {0.25, 0.5, 1.0}, as % RMSE against b = 0; share 0.85 reported beside it
readings.reference: ref32's four-seed mean (seeds 9-12), unrouted, through the same grid

protocol.decision: An item is GO when (a) its R2 at b = 0.5 is at least 0.05 points below ref32's, (b) its four-seed standalone October non-LIRF RMSE is below ref32's, and (c) the paired-day 95% interval of the proxy RMSE difference between the item's and ref32's tables at b = 0.5 lies below zero. If more than one item is GO, the one with the lowest R2 at b = 0.5 is carried forward. A GO goes to a separately declared development round on the clean line's footing (hardware named), control = the v46 stack; every upload is the user's decision. Without a GO the combination is closed.
